identity.title: One Settings tab 'Studio' with one subtab per setting-owning Studio module; namespace and Engine Profile fields held as declared gaps

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-ARC-029] STUDIO SETTINGS TREE. Under [GUI-DESKTOP-014] Studio contributes one Settings tab `Studio` with one subtab per Studio module that owns a user-facing setting. DECLARED GAP, not settled here: SET-SCOPE-001 (Section 10.17.1) admits only the namespaces `data-roots`, `view-defaults`, `retention` and `feature-toggles`, and Studio tool defaults (brush, selection, export stage) fit none of them; the asset-local settings schema uses namespace `studio` marked `namespace_status: spec_delta_pending` and claims no SET-SCOPE-001 namespace until the spec owner decides a module namespace or a mapping. The Engine Profile fields Studio binds for its render providers (GPU/CPU provider, budgets) are likewise not yet declared.
